title: Saturday, Rebranded — PointCast 25 / 2029
dek: Twenty-five new abstract marks, three future stadiums, two student-gear studies, and one visual argument: the sport already has brands; what it needs are better places
body:
PointCast took its current college-football Top 25 and treated it as a visual expansion draft for the year 2029.

Every school receives a wholly original abstract mark, a place-derived name, a future-stadium move, a campus intervention, and repairable student gear. The systems begin with landscape, weather, public infrastructure, and local culture—not widened letters, black alternates, or polished mascot silhouettes.

The edition includes a filterable 25-mark signal wall, browser-local keeping, permanent human and JSON pages for every school, five identity specimen houses, three imagined civic stadiums, two student-gear lookbooks, six creative-director rules, and ten original generated visual plates.

This is an unofficial speculative editorial design project. It is not commissioned, approved, licensed, or endorsed by any school, conference, athletic program, stadium, or governing body. The imagined environments are not announced plans, and none of the gear is licensed merchandise or offered for sale.

media.alt: An imagined 2029 college-football stadium beneath a translucent rain roof with timber structure, visible cisterns, campus tram, and students in abstract rain capes
